description: This file is a JavaScript/TypeScript module used for scanning source code files to detect and manage usage of raw fetch calls in a codebase, particularly for debugging, auditing, or enforcing security policies within a project.

methods.name: findRawFetchCallLines
methods.description: Analyzes source code content to identify lines where raw 'fetch' calls are made, using TypeScript AST parsing.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Executes the process to scan for raw fetch usages in the specified source roots, using a guard with an allowlist.
